manual_findings.finding: Treatment-naive MERIT observations and treatment-experienced screening-to-baseline assay-result changes must not imply same-cohort causality.
Only a CCR5/fusion combination can suppress the variants is not established by supplied sources.
A finite-sensitivity assay cannot verify absolute zero minor non-R5 variants.
Pre-existing CXCR4 reservoir outgrowth and retained-CCR5 resistance are already documented; PMID16641282 was retrieved but omitted from the model packet.

experiment_novelty_check: fail as framed; a narrower novel question is not established by this run
demo_suitability: Supervised evidence-review demo only; do not present the proposed experiment as scientifically validated novelty.
